+def _quotas(data):
+    jobs = [j for j in data["jobs"] if j["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+    k = data["k"]
+    required = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    if not required.issubset({j["id"] for j in jobs}):
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = [j["id"] for j in subset]
+        if not required.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(subset, key=lambda j: (j["start"], j["end"], j["id"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["start"] < ordered[i-1]["end"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+        selected = sorted(ids)
+        value = sum(j["value"] for j in subset)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and selected < best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
